mapper.select: SELECT driver_idx, driver_id, driver_pwd, driver_name, driver_region, driver_contact, driver_birthdate, driver_gender, created_at, driver_lat, driver_lon, display_addr, admin_idx FROM tb_driver WHERE driver_lat IS NOT NULL AND driver_lon IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(created_at, '1970-01-01') DESC

SELECT driver_idx, driver_id, driver_pwd, driver_name, driver_region, driver_contact, driver_birthdate, driver_gender, created_at, driver_lat, driver_lon, display_addr, admin_idx FROM tb_driver WHERE driver_idx = #{driverIdx} LIMIT 1
